authority.change_policy: Preserve the approved original appearance. Visible changes require old/new side-by-side evidence and explicit user approval; never regenerate golden files to hide differences.

specs.classification: Calibration and component specifications, not additional global token families.

calibration_layout.resize_behavior: Anchor at top-left; a larger window reveals background and a smaller window clips. No responsive reflow.
calibration_layout.boundary: These are measurements of the approved Gallery calibration canvas, not universal spacing or device breakpoints.

typography_policy.font_family: System UI font selected through CoreText; fallback comes from the actual shaped run.
typography_policy.label_placement: Fixed slots and integer logical-point origins; preserve approved hierarchy.

radius_derivation.rule: concentric(outer, inset) = max(outer - inset, Badge radius).

rules: Preserve original sidebar, title slot and separators.
Selected row uses RowSelection; selected appearance takes priority over hover.
Unselected hovered row uses ButtonHover; rest has no row fill.
Catalog labels use Body/PrimaryText; page title uses BodyEmphasized/PrimaryText.
Preserve original radius/stroke/opacity demonstration and button-like five-state samples.
The sample is a verification quad, not a finished accessible application control.
Rest/hover/pressed/disabled/focus semantics are taken from the original source, not redefined as a new component theme.
Preserve original ColorRole ordering and swatch layout.
Show existing spacing, radius and stroke roles without creating new design values.

calibration_fixture.boundary: Fixture-only measurements, not a new global typography or size token.

rules: Clip display to whole visible lines; comparison covers the full text canvas.
Private references are optional runtime-only input; never include them in public baseline assets.
IC themes currently compare against standard light/dark references, so this does not establish IC visual equivalence.

navigation.selection_changes_update: Scene, title and menu check state only when actual state changes.
navigation.search: Not part of the approved three-page baseline; future additions must preserve existing appearance.

redraw_policy: Hover entering or leaving a row can redraw.
Pointer movement within one row and repeated selection of the same item do not redraw.
interaction.static_text_pickers: Mouse fixture/width selection; invalid width falls back to fixture default.

motion.boundary: Token resolution policy; not a claim that all app-level accessibility preferences are wired.
motion.scroll_preview: The mixed automatic bounce is a performance/visual harness, not the default product interaction.

implemented_contracts: Theme selection and follow-system appearance/contrast semantics.
Explicit five-state visual samples in the verification page.
accessibility.policy: Visual sample or token coverage does not prove accessible control behavior.

evidence.matrix: Original three pages x four themes x two scales.
evidence.golden_policy: Approved immutable evidence; updates require explicit visual review and user approval.
limits: No private comparison images in the public golden directory.
CI metadata/source checks do not prove same-environment pixel acceptance.
A candidate must have independent actual build/source provenance.

known_gaps.detail: The frozen Gallery and token vocabulary are not a complete production component library or icon system.
Keep original F1 mixed scrolling gate failure; this export does not change that result.
Physical no-dropped-frame behavior and 60-second idle CPU remain unverified.
Current rendering/font evidence is macOS-specific; other platforms have not been accepted.

token_source.value_authority: design/tokens.json is the sole production numeric token source.
token_source.unit_policy: Logical pt is retained in this project schema. No CSS px/rem conversion is implied.
token_source.format_policy: Project-owned schema using DTCG-inspired $type/$value spelling; not full DTCG compliance.
token_source.single_source_migration: Normal Cargo builds compile JSON through the independent Rust generator into OUT_DIR/tokens.rs; no checked-in numeric Rust fallback. Source-only migration receipt binds the unchanged approved 508-channel f32 contract and original visual baseline.
